title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is the archive's sheet numbered '1' (pencil numeral in the lower left). The recto has no legible writing of its own. The only visible marks are very faint show-through from the reverse side or the next sheet.

Those faint traces match the beginning of the next page, 'Sur certains anneaux gradués'. Discernible fragments include:
- M^*
- E^*
- (1.1) π_i ∈ E^*
- End^{(ν)}(M) = Σ Hom(M^i, M^{i+ν})
- pr_ν(u) = Σ π_{i+ν} u π_i
- a boxed formula (1.3)

The mathematics they belong to is set out on the next page. A graded module M^* has finitely many nonzero degrees. E^* is a subring of End(M^*) that contains the canonical projections π_i. Its grading is recovered intrinsically from the π_i by E^{(ν)} = Σ_i π_{i+ν} E π_i. The π_i form a complete system of orthogonal idempotents.

This is the starting point of the 'Poincaré–Hodge algebra' formalism: graded rings of correspondences in which the Künneth projectors are algebraic, in the spirit of the standard conjectures (Künneth type C). None of this content can be read on the present page itself.

ideas.what: Grading on a ring of endomorphisms recovered from a complete family of orthogonal idempotents (projectors π_i), visible only as show-through from the following page
ideas.modern_name: Grading induced by a complete system of orthogonal idempotents / Peirce decomposition; algebraicity of Künneth projectors
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (Peirce decomposition); Künneth-projector algebraicity as standard conjecture C, Grothendieck 1968 / Kleiman 1968
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (Bombay 1968), in spirit; Kleiman's exposés
